citation.authors: Ahmed A, Khan HTA, Asiamah N

cited_by.title: Childhood trauma and where to start

record.population: 734 adults aged 60 and over in Niger State, North-Central Nigeria
record.design: Cross-sectional study using the ACE International Questionnaire
record.finding: 68.4% reported 4 or more ACEs, and 38.4% had three or more chronic conditions. After adjustment, cumulative ACEs remained an independent predictor of multimorbidity (odds ratio 15.58, 95% CI 1.33 to 182.21).
record.note: The confidence interval is very wide, so the size of the effect is uncertain; older adults recalling childhood.
